name: eyevengers-optical
description: Premium Optical Store Management & Billing Application

scripts.bootstrap:
powershell -Command "Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/c ..
ode-env
pm.cmd install' -WorkingDirectory server -NoNewWindow -Wait; Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/c ..
ode-env
pm.cmd install' -WorkingDirectory client -NoNewWindow -Wait"
scripts.dev: powershell -Command "$env:PATH = '$(Get-Location)\node-env;' + $env:PATH; npx concurrently -n 'server,client' -c 'yellow,blue' 'cd server && npm run dev' 'cd client && npm run dev'"
